gloss: way of reading; pronunciation of a character

definitions.gloss: way of reading; how to read
definitions.explanation: The method or manner in which something is read, including the pronunciation assigned to a kanji character or the interpretation of a text.
A particular way of interpreting or making sense of a situation, data, or written material.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{読|よ}み{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me how to read this kanji.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{読|よ}み{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しくて→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えられる→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧。

notes:
{読|よ}み{方|かた} follows the productive ～⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ (way of doing) pattern attached to the verb stem of ⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧.

Sense 1 is especially common in language-learning contexts when asking about kanji pronunciation. Sense 2 extends to interpreting data, situations, or texts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{読|よ}み{方|かた} (how to read a kanji)
- ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{読|よ}み{方|かた} (reading of a name)
- ⟦{地図|ちず}→地図：02914_chizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{読|よ}み{方|かた} (how to read a map)
- ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{読|よ}み{方|かた} (how to interpret data)
